svg.title: Friday — Proactive path (no model)
svg.text: Friday — Proactive path: what happens before he asks
The opener, the pushes and the evening wrap-up are computed by the server from his real calendar, to-dos and reminders. No model is asked.
WHEN SHE COMES TO FIND HIM
only, so he is never told
what Friday finished for him is counted, not guessed
complete_task · or a tap on Done
One line per loop Friday closed. Undo
takes the line back out; "no longer
needed" is not counted as closed.
What she closed for him today, what is still open, and tomorrow's first
thing and deadlines. On Sundays also: 「这周替你关掉了 N 件」 (N loops
This count is the product's long-term KPI.
Why no model here: these are the moments he trusts most and sees first. Computing them on the server makes them instant, free and never wrong about a time or a count. One exception: the first
time a calendar title appears, names.py asks the model once for a short name (「FYP meeting with mentor」 → 「见导师」) and caches it.
Friday 0.9.0 · follows src/presence.py, src/nudges.py and src/closed.py.
